If you're a good shot, probably the .40, less rounds needed. 9mm is my daily carry(sometimes .380 bursa+) because double stack is nice.
Another thread is recommending a revolver for my ccw, which I wasn't considering before but am now.

Concealed carry is something you have to practice it's going to be a little confusing at first but just keep it up and you'll find a comfortable way that does it for you. The two recommendations that I suggest you stick with is one where a sturdy belt and 2 buy a good holster try to avoid the Uncle Mike's one-size-fits-all kind of holsters and get something that was specifically designed for your firearm I've used both an the latter makes a huge difference
